label: Cursor
version: closed source; official docs page https://cursor.com/docs/settings/api-keys and forum staff (deanrie) posts dated 2025-11-28 .. 2026-09-15

sources.note: Official docs: own OpenAI key under Settings > Models; 'all requests are routed through Cursor's servers for final prompt building'; custom keys only for chat models; Tab uses Cursor's own models. The page does not mention the base URL override or the wire format.

Staff (deanrie, 2026-02-22 / 05-22 / 05-25): no direct localhost connections; Override OpenAI Base URL needs a publicly accessible HTTPS endpoint because requests go through Cursor's servers; routing is decided by API key (OpenAI-family models go to the custom endpoint), not by model name.
Staff (deanrie, 2026-08-21 / 09-15): with the override on, built-in OpenAI-family models are also routed to the custom endpoint (global toggle, no per-model routing yet).

Staff (deanrie, 2025-12-01 .. 2026-06-25): BYOK only supports /v1/chat/completions; a bug sends a Responses-API-shaped payload to that path (user reports: body has `input`, no `messages`); suggested fix is a proxy that converts the payload.
Staff (deanrie, 2025-11-28): GPT-5/5.1 Codex models need /v1/responses while BYOK 'currently only supports /v1/chat/completions'.

setup.baseUrl: Cursor Settings > Models > API Keys: enable the OpenAI API Key, then enable 'Override OpenAI Base URL'. Whether to include /v1 is not documented by Cursor (staff ask users whether their URL includes /v1; community guides use .../v1) - assume WITH /v1. Must be a public HTTPS URL.
setup.model: Add the agent name as a custom model manually (e.g. agent/sample); do not reuse a built-in model name (Cursor rejects it as 'already available').
setup.apiKey: OpenAI API Key field; forwarded by Cursor's backend (staff: key is not persisted after the request completes).
setup.notes: Cursor sends requests from ITS OWN SERVERS, not from the desktop app, so http://localhost URLs are unreachable (use a tunnel such as ngrok/Cloudflare Tunnel). The override is global for OpenAI-family models, Tab/autocomplete never uses it, and Anthropic/Gemini models use separate settings. Wire format details (headers, stream_options, tools, tool_choice, parallel_tool_calls, content shape) are NOT documented anywhere official; do not build compatibility assumptions beyond the endpoint path. Known risk: Agent-mode / GPT-5-family requests may be sent as a Responses-API payload to /v1/chat/completions (staff-acknowledged bug as of 2026-06-25).
